resources.title: Airflow DAG Pattern Reference
resources.description: A single compiled Python/SQL file collecting the real, working pattern taught in each chapter — the minimal DAG skeleton, task dependencies and XComs, the Connections/Hook/Snowflake pattern, branching with the correct join trigger rule, and the full ELT-plus-dbt-plus-retries-plus-alerting shape from Chapter 5 — organized chapter by chapter so you can find and adapt the exact pattern you need without hunting back through lesson guides.

resources.title: Airflow Troubleshooting Checklist
resources.description: Lesson 28's four-step diagnostic checklist (read the log, check upstream status, check Connections, classify code bug vs. environment issue) as a real one-page reference, plus the code-bug-vs-environment-issue signal table and a blank incident-note template to fill in the next time a task actually fails in production.

resources.title: Snowflake Connection Extra-Field Template
resources.description: A fill-in-the-blanks JSON template matching exactly what Lesson 16 says goes in a Snowflake Connection's Extra field (account, warehouse, database, role) alongside the standard Login/Password/Schema fields — copy it, replace the placeholder values with your own account's details, and paste the Extra object straight into Airflow's Connection form.
